needed.suggestion: Construct a footway along the left side of the road to provide a safe pedestrian crossing route.
Construct a footway along the right side of the road to provide a safe pedestrian crossing route.
Install a pedestrian refuge island at the signalised crossing to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians on this wide urban road.
Install dropped kerbs at the signalised crossing to improve accessibility for all pedestrians.
Install street lighting along the right side of the road to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians and drivers.
